summary: The diff implements most of the required features: REQ-1 (admin auth reset with default credentials), REQ-2 (login page rebuild and route structure), and REQ-4 (removal of Coming Soon placeholders). However, REQ-3 is only partially addressed — the frontend mutations include actor null checks, but the Motoko backend (main.mo) still retains principal-based authorization checks on write functions (setStoreUpiId and equivalents), which will continue to reject calls from anonymous/session-based frontend flows. Additionally, ShopStatusToggle and AdminSettingsPage still gate saves behind Internet Identity authentication rather than the new session-based admin flow.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin-only write functions in the Motoko backend must not perform a principal-based authorization check that rejects calls from the anonymous/session-based admin flow.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo still contains AccessControl.hasPermission checks on setStoreUpiId and other write functions that will reject anonymous principal calls from the session-based frontend admin flow, causing continued Unauthorized errors.

missing_requirements.requirement: ShopStatusToggle and AdminSettingsPage save operations must work with the session-based admin login, not require Internet Identity authentication.
missing_requirements.reason: ShopStatusToggle checks identity (Internet Identity) and disables the toggle if not authenticated via Internet Identity. AdminSettingsPage similarly gates handleSaveUpi and handleSaveSlogan behind isAuthenticated (Internet Identity). Users who logged in with admin/admin123 via the session-based login still cannot save settings.

hallucinated_features.description: A migration.mo file was added to the backend with a stub migration module.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention adding a migration module or any backend migration infrastructure. This was not requested.
